utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. Let me know what still needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll make a clear list and let you know what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll check for anything I can help with while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the basics for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—please bring sturdy gloves, a flashlight, and any basic tools you have. I’ll sort the rest and send you the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I'll bring gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools. Send me the time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the repair drive happening this week?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the timing and pickup details first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — please confirm the timing and pickup details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to ask if you needed a hand with anything. I might forget a step or two, but I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — could you help me sort the donated screws and check the tape inventory? That’d keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the screws and check the tape inventory right now. If I wander off mentally, just point me back here.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the exact repair drive details again? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure—sorry, I’ve been a bit scattered. What details do you need me to repeat?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’d like the date, time, address, and what items you want people to bring or fix. If there are any special instructions, please include those too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re still gathering donations and tools, and I’m checking with a couple folks about pickup times. If you can help this afternoon, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help this afternoon — just tell me where to meet and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and set aside anything we can lend out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort through the donated tools and set aside anything we can lend out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive location posted yet, but I’m keeping an eye out. If you spot it first, let me know and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll let you know as soon as I spot the location.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep checking too and share it if I find it first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Tess, you should come by the repair drive—there’s always a good crowd, and I’ll make sure you hear about the details first!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’d love that—count me in! Just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, what’s the latest on the repair drive—do you need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mina. I’m still sorting a few things out, but I could use help checking who still needs repairs and maybe spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can check who still needs repairs and help spread the word. Who should I start with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll keep it simple and repeat the plan to folks around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that would really help. I’m still piecing things together, so a simple repeat would go a long way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll tell folks it’s a repair drive to help neighbors fix things up together, and I’ll keep repeating that simple plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving. I can help organize the sign-up list and keep track of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’d appreciate that — I can bring by my list of repairs later.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — bring it by whenever you like, and I’ll add it to the list. We’ll keep everything organized and make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is moving along nicely. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be kind of you, Tess. Please let me know if you hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Eli — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new about it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. What’s left to do?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: A few things are still open — mostly sorting donations and loading the truck. If you can help, I’ll point you to the next spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can do that — point me to the donations, and I’ll start loading the truck after.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much yet, but I’m glad the repair drive is happening. What do you need most help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly tools and a steady pair of hands, if anyone’s willing. I’d be grateful for whatever people can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with tools and hands. Tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—let’s start at the corner by the mailboxes, then check the side gate and the loose board near the walkway.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll start by the mailboxes and work my way down the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be great, Jules—thank you. Can you share the date, time, and where people should meet so I can pass it along accurately?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send you the date, time, and meeting spot as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I missed the details—what’s happening again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday—folks can bring small broken items, and we’ll help fix what we can. If you want, I can send you the time and location.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please send me the time and location—I’d like to stop by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Much appreciated, Ira — if you spot anyone in need of a hand, send them my way. I’ve got a few tools ready to lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll pass folks along if I hear anything. Thanks for having the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Could you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes at my place this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can help sort the tools and label the boxes this afternoon. What time should I come over?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we should make sure we have the right supplies and a clear plan first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good point—what supplies do we still need, and who’s handling the list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to confirm what’s already on hand first, then I can help track down the missing supplies and keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please, save me a spot—I can bring a few supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ve got you on the list—thank you for bringing supplies! I’ll let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I should’ve had that handy. I don’t have the time nailed down yet, but I can check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just let me know as soon as you have it and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive organized, Nell. Let’s start with the most urgent homes and make sure everyone knows where to bring requests.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great, Rosa — I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so I can help spread the word. Just tell me where folks should bring their requests, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — have people bring requests to my porch or leave a note at the community board, and I’ll sort them by urgency. If you hear of any especially serious repairs, send those my way first.
